data_fields.name: growth_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 1/7 of current count per period (integer part plus one draw for the remainder)

data_fields.name: growth_period
data_fields.donor_constant: one calendar week of 7 days (not a seconds value)

data_fields.name: regrow_from_zero
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: a stack with count 0 never grows

best_idea: Grow a living population by its exact expected rate, using one random draw to pay the fractional part, capped at the zone's limit, and never restart a cleared stack from zero.
decision_why: Take the stochastic-rounding growth step and its cap and no-regrow-from-zero guards as a server step for living camps, with the rate and cap as zone data; reject it as a respawn rule, because the donor never refills a killed stack and row 23 respawn and grace timers still need their own design.
acceptance: Server test: over 10,000 growth draws from a camp of 75 members, the mean growth is within 0.1 of 75/7 (about 10.71), no step takes the camp above the zone cap, and a camp at 0 members stays at 0 after any number of ticks.
